name: JetBlue Premier Card

apr.notes: APR for purchases: 19.49% to 29.49% variable based on creditworthiness. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for first 12 billing cycles within 45 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 29.49%. APR for cash advances: 29.74%. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10).

fx_fee.notes: Disclosure states 'Foreign transaction fee: 0%.' Page also states 'No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.'

categories.label: 2X points at restaurants and eligible grocery stores

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire. No blackout dates — any seat, any time on JetBlue-operated flights. Points pooling with family and friends. Cash + Points starting from as few as 500 points.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 on purchases and paying the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Access to BlueHouse™
benefits.description: Complimentary access to BlueHouse for cardmembers with eligible fares.

benefits.title: Priority Pass™ Lounge Access
benefits.description: Access to over 1,800 participating lounges and travel experiences in over 700 airports in 146 countries with Priority Pass.

benefits.title: TrueBlue Travel Statement Credits
benefits.description: Earn up to $300 in statement credits on TrueBlue Travel purchases per calendar year.

benefits.title: Mosaic Status Faster
benefits.description: Earn toward Mosaic with every purchase.

benefits.title: 5,000 Bonus Points Each Anniversary
benefits.description: Earn 5,000 bonus points each year after your JetBlue Premier Card account anniversary.

benefits.title: 15% of Points Back on Award Flights
benefits.description: Get 15% of your points back after you redeem for and travel on an Award Flight.

benefits.title: Points Never Expire
benefits.description: Your points will be ready whenever you are.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: Means you're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 application fee statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck.

benefits.title: Group 3 Boarding
benefits.description: Group 3 boarding on JetBlue-operated flights for the primary cardmember, authorized users, and up to 4 eligible travel companions.

benefits.title: 50% Savings on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 50% savings on eligible inflight purchases on JetBlue-operated flights.

benefits.title: Free First Checked Bag
benefits.description: Free first checked bag for the primary cardmember and up to 3 eligible travel companions on the same itinerary when you use your JetBlue Premier Card on JetBlue-operated flights.

benefits.title: Points Payback
benefits.description: Points Payback allows you to redeem points for a statement credit.

benefits.title: Redeem for Any Seat, Any Time
benefits.description: Points required for an Award flight will vary based on the published base fare at the time of booking.

benefits.title: Cash + Points
benefits.description: Pay for your flight with almost any combination of dollars and TrueBlue points – starting with as few as 500 points.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Companion Pass Statement Credits
benefits.description: Earn up to $2,000 in companion pass statement credits after eligible purchases in a calendar year. Up to $500 after $15,000 in eligible net purchases, and up to $1,500 after $75,000 in eligible net purchases.

benefits.title: 25-Tile Bonus
benefits.description: Receive an annual 25-tile bonus after year-end to fast-track your Mosaic status for the next year.

lounge_access.notes: Priority Pass — over 1,800 participating lounges and travel experiences in over 700 airports in 146 countries
